name: purge-in-flames-without-the-class-bonus-deals-two-damage
notes: Generated bodies gated these cards' [Class Bonus] with IsClassBonusActive($player) and NO class list, which only checks that the player controls any champion and is therefore always true: every champion got the bonus. IsClassBonusActive() now resolves the bare form against the printed class(es) of the card whose ability closure is running (GAInstallClassBonusSourceWrappers() in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php wraps the 32 affected cards' ability closures); a champion matching any of the card's classes satisfies it. Spirit of Fire is not a Mage: 2 damage instead of 3.

rulesClauses: Deal 2 damage to all units except for your champion. Class Bonus: Deal 3 damage to those units instead.

engineBug.summary: Class Bonus effects applied for every champion (bare IsClassBonusActive($player) is always true).
